snippet.title: The Haircut Challenge That Won’t End 😭 #football #viral #shorts #story #footballshorts
snippet.description:
This Man United fan promised he wouldn’t cut his hair until United won five games in a row. At first, it didn’t sound that impossible. Most big clubs manage a five-game winning streak almost every season. But after he started the challenge, United couldn’t even get close, and as the days passed, the whole thing became a meme. Then suddenly, after a change in form, United won four games in a row and were just one win away from finally ending the challenge. The final game was against West Ham, and for a moment, it looked like the wait might finally be over. But after going behind, equalising late, and failing to find the winner, the streak restarted again. After nearly two years of waiting, his hair is still growing.

Then, in the middle of delivering a pitch, his body finally reached its limit. Somehow, he still helped his team secure the victory.
